mapper.sql: merchant_id, brand_id, category_code, merchant_code, merchant_name, address, latitude, longitude, phone
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchants (brand_id, category_code, merchant_code, merchant_name, address, latitude, longitude, phone) VALUES (#{brandId}, #{categoryCode}, #{merchantCode}, #{merchantName}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{phone})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchants ORDER BY merchant_id DESC

SELECT m.merchant_id AS merchantId, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, mb.brand_code AS brandCode, mb.brand_name AS brandName, mc.category_code AS categoryCode, mc.category_name AS categoryName, m.address AS address, m.latitude AS latitude, m.longitude AS longitude,
ROUND( 6371000 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT( POWER(SIN(RADIANS(m.latitude - #{latitude}) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * COS(RADIANS(m.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(m.longitude - #{longitude}) / 2), 2) )), 0 )
NULL
AS distanceMeters, CAST(4.6 AS DECIMAL(2,1)) AS rating, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookmarked_stores bs WHERE bs.user_id = #{userId} AND bs.merchant_id = m.merchant_id AND bs.is_deleted = FALSE ) AS bookmarked FROM merchants m JOIN merchant_categories mc ON mc.category_id = m.category_id LEFT JOIN merchant_brands mb ON mb.brand_id = m.brand_id WHERE m.merchant_id = #{merchantId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM merchants WHERE merchant_code = #{merchantCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE merchants SET brand_id = #{brandId}, category_code = #{categoryCode}, merchant_code = #{merchantCode}, merchant_name = #{merchantName}, address = #{address}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, phone = #{phone} WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
